# compress test fixtures

Generated by `tools/gen_zip_oracle.py` (the python3 zlib /
gzip oracle; provenance in manifest.edn):

```
python3 tools/gen_zip_oracle.py
```

- `corpus.txt` -- the deterministic compressible corpus.
- `zlib_l{0,1,6,9}.bin` -- `zlib.compress(corpus, level)`
  streams; mino's zlib-decompress must decode each one.
- `gzip_l{0,1,6,9}.gz` -- `gzip.compress(corpus,
  compresslevel=level, mtime=0)` members.
- `manifest.edn` -- sizes, SHA-256s, and the pinned header
  vectors. Compressed bodies are never compared between
  mino and python (the R4 golden split): the streams pin
  the decode side, the header vectors pin the writers.

A regenerated `random*`-style fixture does not exist here;
the corpus is fully deterministic, so regeneration diffs
empty on the same python3/zlib.
